
8. Agents
An agent is a coding assistant. Only detected agents can be configured.
This content declares no agent configuration yet. On or off changes nothing today.
On means this machine receives agent configuration at a later update, when you add some.

Agent: claude
When on, Fleet writes only entries it owns and never touches the agent's login.
When off, outputs Fleet wrote earlier stay in place.
Setup stops before writing if it finds a value Fleet did not write.
  on   Fleet manages its skills, MCP entries, rules, and packages. (Current.)
  off  Fleet leaves its configuration alone. The agent still works.
Press Enter alone to choose on.
claude [on]:
